invariants.rationale: The HoodieEngineContext parameter 'context' should be non-null at method entry for further operations.
The 'compactionInstantTime' string parameter should be non-null to represent a valid timestamp.
Typically, instant time strings are expected to be non-empty.
The 'context' parameter must be an instance of HoodieEngineContext.
Instant time should contain visible characters and not be empty or only whitespace.
